verdict.rationale: Skyfire's pay/kya-pay tokens are scoped, amount-committed, expiry-bound credentials (10s–24h expiry, committed amount ceiling, merchant/service-specific issuance, identity requirements) that replace raw card numbers for agent checkout, per docs on token creation, charge-token API, and payments-settlement. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs, and clearer documentation of granular merchant-restriction enforcement (vs. per-service token issuance).
